responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/flock/linux.rs: Implements the Linux-specific file-lock backend by opening the lock file and acquiring shared or exclusive advisory locks with `libc::flock`, including optional nonblocking behavior and detection of OS errors that mean locking is unsupported. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/flock/unix.rs: Implements the non-Linux Unix file-lock backend by opening the lock file and managing shared or exclusive advisory locks with `fcntl` record locking, including blocking vs nonblocking acquisition, explicit unlock-on-drop behavior, and detection of OS errors that mean locking is unsupported. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/flock/unsupported.rs: Provides the fallback flock backend for platforms without file-lock support by exposing the same `Lock` API but always failing lock creation and classifying all such failures as unsupported-platform errors. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/flock/windows.rs: Implements the Windows file-lock backend by opening the lock file with compatible sharing settings and acquiring shared or exclusive whole-file locks through `LockFileEx`, with tracing around lock operations and detection of the Windows error used to signal unsupported locking.
